messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Hosted embeddings error-rate increased from 0.3% -> 2.7% on production embeddings route (embed-small). Suggested action: PARTIAL ROLLBACK traffic slice for embeddings to v3.1.4 (previous stable). Auto-rollback scheduled in 12m unless overridden. Details: /telemetry/embedded/3067

maria: noticed spike coincident with runtime kernel tweak merged in 2.2.0. This seems limited to embed routes. Can we target rollback to embeddings-only?

jack: +1 for targeted rollback. rolling back whole release will affect chat endpoints unnecessarily. but confirm we can do route-level pinning without breaking session affinity.

ops-oncall: oncall here. we can do route-level traffic-slice rollback. prefer manual intervention to validate trace correlation first. request 8m hold to run targeted live-checks and error grouping.

maria: ack. starting grouping query: `sentry query "error.type:Timeout OR error.type:InvalidResponse" env:prod route:embed-small`

deploy-bot: Autorollback timer reduced to 8m by operator override. Current timer: 8m.

erin: i'll prepare the rollback playbook and comms snippet. if we rollback, need to pin schema version for dedicated pools and update release notes internal draft.

jack: running probe now: `for i in {1..20}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://prod.embed/health?size=small; sleep 0.5; done`

ops-oncall: probe results -> 18/20 500s, avg latency 1.2s, error rate ~90% on embed-small (confirmed). This looks persistent. recommending manual partial rollback now.

maria: agreed, do targeted rollback to v3.1.4 for embed-small route. I'll coordinate.

jack: manual steps: 1) `infra pin-route --route embed-small --version 3.1.4` 2) `infra traffic-slice --route embed-small --from 10%->100% --window 30s` 3) `infra monitor --check p95,errors --duration 5m`

ops-oncall: executing step1 now.

ops-oncall: pin-route complete. traffic-slice starting 10% -> 100% over 30s.

commms-bot: Drafting internal note: "Incident: embeddings errors on prod. Partial rollback executed for embed-small (-> v3.1.4). Monitoring ongoing. Customer-facing note pending confirmation."

jack: traffic flip complete. rolling monitor for 5m.

ops-oncall: 1m into monitoring: error-rate down to 0.4%, p95 latency stable. traces show kernel flag no longer applied on rolled back version.

maria: good. keep watching 15m. also pin release in release tracker: `release: v3.2.0` -> annotate: partial rollback on embed-small to v3.1.4 due to regression.

erin: holding public release note until we confirm stability for 30m. internal release notes updated with rollback rationale. legal asked to review the customer blurb for regulated customers.

ops-oncall: 10m sustained: metrics stable, error-rate baseline restored. recommending close and document root cause as kvcache kernel flag interaction with embed-small memory path.

maria: filing followup ticket: INF-4821 "kvcache kernel tweak causes embed-small errors" and assigning to eng-runtime.

jack: closing thread: manual partial rollback executed, autorollback canceled. comms: internal note posted, customer note on hold until legal signoff. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: ACTION: autorollback canceled by operator override. State: resolved (partial rollback executed).
